source_caption:
Michael Jackson makes a quick but unforgettable cameo in Men in Black II, showing up as “Agent M.”

He appears on a futuristic screen, playfully pleading to be let into the secret alien-fighting organization, delivering the moment with his usual charm and humor. It’s a short scene, but it instantly stands out.

The cameo became one of the film’s most talked-about surprises, mixing pop culture with sci-fi in a fun way and proving that even someone like Jackson was excited to be part of the Men in Black world.

source_details.title: Men in Black II
source_details.synopsis: Men in Black II (stylized as MIIB in promotional material) is a 2002 American science fiction action comedy film based on the Marvel Comics series of a similar name based on the conspiracy theory. Produced by Columbia Pictures and Amblin Entertainment in association with MacDonald/Parkes Productions, and distributed by Sony Pictures Releasing, it is the sequel to Men in Black (1997) and the second installment in the Men in Black film series. The film was directed by Barry Sonnenfeld from a screenplay by Robert Gordon and Barry Fanaro, and it stars Tommy Lee Jones and Will Smith, with Lara Flynn Boyle, Johnny Knoxville, Rosario Dawson, Tony Shalhoub, and Rip Torn in supporting roles.
